newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher, lifted by BT/MCI deal.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher, lifted by BT/MCI deal.

text.p: A jump in British Telecom shares lifted an otherwise cautious London market at the open as it digested weekend news of BT's surprise $20 billion merger with America's MCI Communications, traders said.
BT shares climbed 24p to 375p, more than accounting for the 7.2 point gain in the FTSE 100 to 3,955.7.

Elsewhere trading continued the subdued tone of last week with business cautious ahead of the U.S. Presidential elections on Tuesday and as domestic poltical worries revived after the death over the weekend of Conservative MP Barry Porter reduced the ruling Conservative party's majority to one.
